purpose: Compare the fixed shortlist AMZN, KO, PG and VZ without selecting a stock or retuning wheel parameters from the comparison results.
dividends: Use unadjusted stock prices. Accrue gross dividend entitlement on ex-date for shares owned before that session; include unpaid terminal receivables in equity. Credit spendable cash on pay date or the next observed session. Primary buy-and-hold reinvests paid cash at that session closing ask using fractional shares (except terminal liquidation date). Also report the original cash-dividend, non-reinvesting benchmark. No taxes.
assignment: Baseline keeps expiration-only assignment, as in AMZN. Separately report an announced-dividend stress: remove in-the-money covered calls at the close immediately preceding ex-date when bid-side time value is below the announced dividend. This is a deterministic scenario, not actual exercise history.
fairness: Same economic rules and quote filters; fixed ticker-appropriate standard strike grids, rather than the same dollar spacing for differently priced stocks. No changes to the historical AMZN freeze or engine.
interpretation: Exploratory cross-stock comparison after the AMZN outcome was seen. The shortlist is fixed before returns are fetched; these are not a random stock sample or a fresh market holdout. Report every ticker, including insufficient liquidity or missing-data failures. Do not replace a failed ticker with a winner.
benchmark_refinement_reason: Before any candidate return computation, add a fully invested dividend-reinvesting benchmark as primary. Preserve the originally specified cash-dividend benchmark as an explicit sensitivity. No change to the wheel rules, ticker list, dates or option grids.
